name: smwsprites-celeste-controllable-platform
title: Celeste - Controllable Platform
description:
This platform will move in a direction in an horizontal or vertical manner automatically, with the player being able to control how it moves in the opposite axis. See the ASM file for more information.
Note that this requires a patch (that will be installed when you insert the sprite) to be able to use the respawning feature.

v1.1
* Updated for PIXI.
* Somewhat fixed SA-1 conversion (but untested anyways so I'm not putting the tag.
